name: Popcreate
website_meta_description: Popcreate is a boutique print design studio, offering a vibrant and colourful approach to textile design. All of our talented designers have worked across the fashion industry offering a product focused approach to print design.

pages.text: Popcreate design studio 0 Skip to Content Client Work Shop Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu Client Work Shop Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Client Work Folder: Shop Back Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Slide 1 Slide 1 (current slide) Slide 2 Slide 2 (current slide) Slide 3 Slide 3 (current slide) Slide 4 Slide 4 (current slide) Slide 5 Slide 5 (current slide) Slide 6 Slide 6 (current slide) Slide 7 Slide 7 (current slide) Slide 8 Slide 8 (current slide) Slide 9 Slide 9 (current slide) Popcreate by Faye Angel Popcreate is a London based textile design studio set up in 2020 by Faye Angel. I offer a vibrant approach to print, colour, trend design and buying print artworks for fashion and interiors. The Popcreate team is a group of highly experienced textile fashion designers. We have all worked for retailers so we understand the demands and needs of brands. The digital print collection has a strong focus on striking colour palettes, with unexpected pops of colour throughout. Inspiration is drawn from vintage archive pieces, original photography and hand rendered artworks, the prints feel contemporary and trend relevant. Every original artwork is in full industry repeat, we offer free re-colours. We can digitise the vintage prints for you making them come to life for the modern world. Email me to find out more, Love + kisses Faye x info@popcreate.co.uk The design studio consists of; -Ready to buy digital PRINT collection. -BESPOKE client commissions. -Colour + print TREND analysis. Our services curated especially for your brand. Print Collection - The studios offers exclusive digital artworks, in full repeat, to view/purchase sign up here . Bespoke Commissions - If you can’t find the right print in the ready to buy collection, then commission Popcreate to design the perfect artwork for your brand. Trend Analysis - Let Popcreate inspire you with seasonal print and colour trend flashes. Print Collection. Scroll through the vibrant Popcreate exclusive ready to buy print collection, to find the perfect artwork for your brand. sign up to view the collection Curated commissions. The Popcreate design team love to get creative for you. We work with a global client base providing vibrant new print direction + colour harmonies to brands. click to work with us Client Work Shop Trend Blog About Contact Made with Squarespace

Popcreate 0 Skip to Content Client Work Shop Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu Client Work Shop Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Client Work Folder: Shop Back Shop The Collection Trend Blog About Contact Popcreate is a new and exciting design studio, working with global brands across the fashion industry. As well as being able to buy exclusive and original artworks from our ready to buy print collection, we also work on bespoke prints and colour trends specific to your brands needs that work into your seasonal concepts. Click below to see examples of our bespoke client commissions or sign up here to shop the collection. Alexandra Miro Coast Karen Millen Me Me X New Look Nobodyschild Dress Like a Mum Warehouse Popcreate studio design beautiful, trend relevant prints with a colour pop twist. We work closely with our clients to deliver a product that stands out from the crowd. Shop the collection here We are specialists in our field and adore working on bespoke commissions for our clients. Our creative process always starts with original inspiration, which usually means putting paint brush to paper. Contact us here to commission a project. Popcreate prints are hand-executed by our amazing and experienced textile artists. Like what you see? Would you like to view the collection? Click here . We work with fashion brands both big and small from all across the world. We aim to inspire our clients and elevate their product with Popcreate’s prints. Sign up here and get inspired with our free trend service. Client Work Shop Trend Blog About Contact Made with Squarespace
